target.title: policy: cover gateway node commands
target.body:
## Summary
- add policy evidence for `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` and `gateway.nodes.denyCommands` entries
- add `gateway.nodes.denyCommands` policy metadata and shape validation
- report `policy/gateway-node-command-denied` when policy-denied node commands are not denied by OpenClaw config
- document the new policy rule in the Policy CLI and plugin reference docs
- classify `gateway.nodes.allowCommands.*` in policy config coverage

## Policy syntax / evidence / finding contract

Policy syntax added by this PR:

```jsonc
{
  "gateway": {
    "nodes": {
      "denyCommands": ["system.run"]
    }
  }
}
```

`gateway.nodes.denyCommands` is an exact, case-sensitive deny-superset rule. An equal-or-stricter policy must include every command required by the baseline deny list. Empty or missing `denyCommands` means this rule is not active.

OpenClaw config evidence collected by policy doctor:

```jsonc
{
  "gateway": {
    "nodes": {
      "allowCommands": ["mcp.help", "mcp.invoke", "system.run"],
      "denyCommands": ["system.run"]
    }
  }
}
```

The evidence scanner records concrete config entries as:

```text
kind=nodeAllowCommand command=system.run source=oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/allowCommands/#2
kind=nodeDenyCommand  command=system.run source=oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands/#0
```

Finding emitted when policy requires a deny but config does not provide it:

```json
{
  "checkId": "policy/gateway-node-command-denied",
  "severity": "error",
  "message": "Gateway node command 'system.run' is denied by policy but not denied by OpenClaw config.",
  "path": "openclaw config",
  "ocPath": "oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands",
  "target": "oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands",
  "requirement": "oc://policy.jsonc/gateway/nodes/denyCommands",
  "fixHint": "Add 'system.run' to gateway.nodes.denyCommands or update policy after review."
}
```

The finding clears when the config deny list contains the required exact command id. `allowCommands` evidence is collected for coverage and context; this PR only enforces the policy deny-superset contract.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Managed policy can now require privileged gateway node commands such as `system.run` to be denied in OpenClaw config via `gateway.nodes.denyCommands`. The policy doctor reports the missing config deny and clears once the config denylist covers the policy denylist.

Real environment tested:
Windows 11 PowerShell, `C:\src\openclaw-fork` checkout at PR head `cfe901e17963d9fe1833266a2758f125d7a51762`, source-harness invocation of the real policy doctor health checks through `runDoctorLintChecks`. The harness wrote real temporary `openclaw.jsonc` and `policy.jsonc` files under `%TEMP%`; no cloud gateway or Lobster deployment was involved.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Ran a Node/tsx source harness from the repo root that imported `registerPolicyDoctorChecks` and `runDoctorLintChecks`.
2. Case `missing-config-deny`: wrote `policy.jsonc` with `gateway.nodes.denyCommands: ["system.run"]` and `openclaw.jsonc` with `gateway.nodes.allowCommands: ["mcp.help", "mcp.invoke", "system.run"]` and no config `denyCommands`.
3. Case `satisfied-config-deny`: wrote the same policy plus `openclaw.jsonc` with `gateway.nodes.denyCommands: ["system.run"]`.

Evidence after fix:
```text
CASE missing-config-deny
workspace: C:\Users\giodl\AppData\Local\Temp\oc-policy-missing-config-deny-Xk9xXX
openclaw.jsonc gateway.nodes: {"allowCommands":["mcp.help","mcp.invoke","system.run"]}
policy.jsonc gateway.nodes.denyCommands: ["system.run"]
finding.checkId: policy/gateway-node-command-denied
finding.severity: error
finding.message: Gateway node command 'system.run' is denied by policy but not denied by OpenClaw config.
finding.ocPath: oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands
finding.target: oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands
finding.requirement: oc://policy.jsonc/gateway/nodes/denyCommands
finding.fixHint: Add 'system.run' to gateway.nodes.denyCommands or update policy after review.

CASE satisfied-config-deny
workspace: C:\Users\giodl\AppData\Local\Temp\oc-policy-satisfied-config-deny-jngRgn
openclaw.jsonc gateway.nodes: {"allowCommands":["mcp.help","mcp.invoke","system.run"],"denyCommands":["system.run"]}
policy.jsonc gateway.nodes.denyCommands: ["system.run"]
policy/gateway-node-command-denied findings: none
```

Observed result after fix:
The missing config-deny case emits exactly one `policy/gateway-node-command-denied` error targeted at `oc://openclaw.config/gateway/nodes/denyCommands`. The satisfied config-deny case emits no finding for that check.

What was not tested:
This was source-harness policy doctor proof, not a live Lobster/cloud gateway run. Cloud gateway rollout behavior for `system.run` allowlisting remains a separate Lobster deployment concern.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts --reporter=dot`
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`
- `./node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts extensions/policy/src/policy-state.ts scripts/lib/policy-config-coverage.jsonc`
- `./node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts extensions/policy/src/policy-state.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd --check docs/cli/policy.md docs/plugins/reference/policy.md extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts extensions/policy/src/policy-state.ts scripts/lib/policy-config-coverage.jsonc`
- `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md`
- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm tsgo:test:extensions`
- `codex review --base upstream/main`

## Notes
This gives managed policy a way to require privileged gateway node commands such as `system.run` to be present in `gateway.nodes.denyCommands` unless a deployment intentionally relaxes policy. The rule uses the existing `denylist-superset` strictness pattern and keeps node command IDs case-sensitive.
